concerns.text: The majority of tasks (e.g., T001, T001b, T002, T003, T004, T005a, T005b, T006, T007, T008, T009, T010, T011, T011b, T012, T014, T016, T016b, T016c, T018, T019, T020, T021, T022, T023, T024, T025, T025b, T025c, T026, T027, T028, T029, T030, T031, T032, T033a‑c, T034a, T035a, T036a, T037, T038, T039, T040, T041a) describe an implementation action but do not specify a concrete deliverable artifact (file, directory, script output) nor a verifiable acceptance criterion (e.g., file existence, schema validation, test pass). Without explicit verification, an implementer cannot deterministically know when the task is complete, making these tasks unexecutable. Each task should be revised to name the exact artifact it produces and how that artifact will be validated (e.g., "Create `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` and verify it validates against the JSON schema", "Run `pytest tests/unit/test_labeling.py` and require all tests to pass", "Generate `data/raw/synthetic_episodes.parquet` with ≥ 5 000 rows and confirm checksum matches entry in `data/checksums.json`", etc.).
